digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow (macOS test execution)
propositions: macOS pytest execution on the default and integration suites is I/O-bound with thousands of small Git repository writes to runner.temp
an APFS RAM disk strategy following OSS precedent (Apple Git CI, Aeron) was implemented and measured against a no-RAM control (run 31868300174: 17m26s default, 20m36s job)

all treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) were slower than the no-RAM control (18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, 20m00s respectively) and failed to meet the predeclared 5% improvement threshold
the RAM-disk experiment was rejected and reverted because storage placement did not reduce wall time and added 71-98 seconds of observability/cleanup overhead

secondary defects were discovered and fixed: intentionally read-only workflow snapshot fixtures blocked recursive basetemp cleanup, and nested pytest inherited cacheprovider state causing REPO_ROOT contamination
the merged fix (commit 7d908fbbc6da12f8e274b3ef1e3a2357377799ef) restores both pytest tiers to runner.temp with unchanged selectors, markers, workers, timeouts, platforms, and coverage behavior
